channel.title: AK Pulse Live
channel.description: Fresh Alaska headlines, weather, community updates, and curated news feeds.

item.title: Anchorage Weather: Today | NWS Anchorage
item.description: 48°F | 5 to 10 mph S | Chance Rain And Snow Showers then Chance Light Rain A chance of rain and snow showers before 10am, then a chance of rain. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 48. South wind 5 to 10 mph, with gusts as high as 20 mph. Chance of precipitation is 40%. Source: NWS Anchorage.

item.title: Murphy powers past Higgins to reach Crucible final | BBC News
item.description: Shaun Murphy powers to a 17-15 victory over John Higgins to reach his fifth World Championship final at the Crucible Theatre in Sheffield. Source: BBC News.

item.title: Norris takes dominant win in Miami sprint race | BBC News
item.description: Lando Norris takes McLaren's first victory of the 2026 season with a dominant drive from pole position in the Miami Grand Prix sprint race. Source: BBC News.

item.title: Germany says US troop withdrawal 'foreseeable' as Nato seeks clarification | BBC News
item.description: German Defence Minister Boris Pistorius said the US decision to withdraw 5,000 troops was to be expected. Source: BBC News.

item.title: Imprisoned Iranian Nobel Peace Prize winner in critical condition | NPR News
item.description: Narges Mohammadi, an Iranian activist and 2023 Nobel Peace Prize laureate, was hospitalized after collapsing in prison. Her family says her condition has deteriorated since a March heart attack. Source: NPR News.

item.title: Airlines reduce, cap fares for Spirit travelers looking to rebook canceled flights | ABC News
item.description: The Department of Transportation said Saturday the majority of airlines will be capping tickets prices for Spirit travelers who need to rebook their cancelled flights. Source: ABC News.

item.title: California to begin ticketing driverless cars that violate traffic laws | BBC News
item.description: Under the new rules, police will be able to issue tickets directly to the car's manufacturer when an autonomous vehicle breaks a traffic law. Source: BBC News.

item.title: Kemi Badenoch apologises after Bloody Sunday footage used in video | BBC News
item.description: Foyle MP Colum Eastwood called on Badenoch to personally apologise after the video was posted online. Source: BBC News.

item.title: Trump likes the idea of the government owning some US companies but took a pass on Spirit Airlines | ABC Business
item.description: President Donald Trump has taken a shine to the government taking stakes in the private sector Source: ABC Business.

item.title: Crowd shrinks as Berkshire Hathaway's new CEO leads the annual meeting for the first time Saturday | ABC Business
item.description: Berkshire Hathaway’s new CEO Greg Abel opened the first annual meeting without Warren Buffett on stage Saturday Source: ABC Business.

item.title: New Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel begins leading first annual meeting without Warren Buffett on stage | ABC Business
item.description: New Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel begins leading first annual meeting without Warren Buffett on stage Source: ABC Business.

item.title: Four in hospital after drive-by shooting | BBC News
item.description: Four people have been taken to hospital after multiple shots were fired from a vehicle in Brixton. Source: BBC News.

item.title: US threatens shipping firms with sanctions if they pay Iran tolls | BBC News
item.description: The warning comes as President Donald Trump said he was "not excited" by Iran's latest proposal for a peace deal. Source: BBC News.

item.title: Alaska Beacon state and legislative daybook for the week of May 4, 2026
item.description: It’s down to the final weeks of the second legislative session of the 34th Legislature. There will be a joint legislative session on Monday to consider an override vote of Gov. Dunleavy’s veto of a bipartisan elections reform bill. The draft budgets for next fiscal year are taking shape, lawmakers… Source: Alaska Beacon.

item.title: Anchorage Weather: Overnight | NWS Anchorage
item.description: 35°F | 10 mph SE | Chance Rain Showers A chance of rain showers. Mostly cloudy, with a low around 35. Southeast wind around 10 mph. Chance of precipitation is 50%. Source: NWS Anchorage.

item.title: College football champion Indiana Hoosiers to visit White House this month: Source | ABC News
item.description: The Indiana Hoosiers -- college football's national champions -- will visit the White House on Monday, May 11, according to a source familiar with the team's plans. Source: ABC News.

item.title: The remarkable life of Zanardi, a 21st century hero who inspired millions | BBC News
item.description: Alex Zanardi was a 21st century hero - a man who inspired millions through his unquenchable spirit in the face of unbelievable adversity, writes Andrew Benson. Source: BBC News.

item.title: Opinion: The everyday tragedy of gun violence | NPR News
item.description: The White House Correspondents Association Dinner was one of several incidents of gun violence in the U.S. last week. Others ended in injuries and fatalities. Source: NPR News.

item.title: US consortium takes over Sheffield Wednesday | BBC News
item.description: Sheffield Wednesday have announced that US consortium Arise Capital Partners has completed a takeover of the club. Source: BBC News.

item.title: Winners, losers and a PM on the brink - what to expect in next week's elections | BBC News
item.description: Believe it or not, Thursday’s local elections aren’t just about the PM’s fate - there’s plenty more at stake. Source: BBC News.

item.title: Sewage and agricultural pollution having 'alarming' impact on UK's underwater forests | BBC News
item.description: Scientists found seagrass meadows affected by sewage had far fewer small invertebrates, like crabs. Source: BBC News.

item.title: Can Trump's latest pick for surgeon general make it through confirmation? | NPR News
item.description: Nicole Saphier, a breast cancer radiologist, is the president's third nominee for surgeon general. Will she get confirmed? Source: NPR News.

item.title: Americans aren't sleeping enough. Here's what could help | NPR News
item.description: Nearly a third of Americans get less than the recommended seven hours of sleep a night. A lot of us struggle to get to bed as we power through tasks or get lost in endless scrolling. Here's help. Source: NPR News.

item.title: Police station car bomb accused appears before court | BBC News
item.description: A 66 year old appears before a court a week after a bomb exploded outside Dunmurry Police Station. Source: BBC News.

item.title: Anchorage Weather: Tonight | NWS Anchorage
item.description: 39°F | 10 to 15 mph SE | Light Rain then Chance Rain And Snow Rain before 4am, then a chance of rain and snow. Cloudy, with a low around 39. Southeast wind 10 to 15 mph. Chance of precipitation is 80%. Source: NWS Anchorage.

item.title: New Netflix documentary reexamines Winnie Mandela's divisive legacy | NPR News
item.description: Winnie Madikizela-Mandela is one of the most revered — and controversial — women in South African history. In a new documentary her granddaughters examine the liberation icon in all her complexity. Source: NPR News.

item.title: Star-studded line-up announced for Celebrity Traitors series two | BBC News
item.description: Miranda Hart, Maya Jama, and Eastenders legend Ross Kemp are among the stars who will go head-to-head in the second series of The Celebrity Traitors. Source: BBC News.

item.title: Smiling Princess Charlotte beams in 11th birthday portrait | BBC News
item.description: Sharing the image on social media, Kensington Palace said: "Wishing Charlotte a very happy 11th birthday!' Source: BBC News.

item.title: Iran live updates: Trump tells Congress hostilities 'have terminated' | ABC News
item.description: Despite facing the 60-day deadline under the War Powers Act, the president is not asking Congress for authorization. Source: ABC News.

item.title: Thirteen killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, health ministry says | BBC News
item.description: Four women and a child are among the dead, as fighting between Israel and Iran-backed Hezbollah continues despite a ceasefire. Source: BBC News.

item.title: Ex-F1 driver and Paralympic cycling champion Zanardi dies | BBC News
item.description: Former Formula 1 driver and Paralympic champion Alex Zanardi dies at the age of 59. Source: BBC News.

item.title: Chris Mason: PM seeks to draw contrast with critics within his party and beyond | BBC News
item.description: In his interview with the Today Programme, Sir Keir Starmer addressed the whirlwind of recent events, from wars to rising antisemitism. Source: BBC News.

item.title: After Assad's fall, Syria's Kurds are left in limbo, feeling abandoned by the U.S. | NPR News
item.description: Caught in limbo after the fall of Syria's Bashar al-Assad, Kurdish families struggle with cold, loss and uncertainty — feeling abandoned by the U.S. allies they once fought alongside. Source: NPR News.

item.title: 2026 Senate races to watch: From most likely to flip to Democratic long shots | NPR News
item.description: Democrats could have a narrow path to winning the Senate, with these specific states on the table. Source: NPR News.

item.title: DeChambeau denies 'completely untrue' PGA talks | BBC News
item.description: American Bryson DeChambeau says it is "completely untrue" he is looking to leave LIV Golf before the end of the year. Source: BBC News.

item.title: England's Wood hoping to bowl again this summer | BBC News
item.description: England pace bowler Mark Wood says he is hoping to bowl later in the summer as he looks to come back from the knee injury that ruined his Ashes. Source: BBC News.

item.title: Spirit Airlines ceases operations after escalating financial struggles | NPR News
item.description: The low-cost carrier, which had been struggling for years, announced it will cease operations. Spirit had been seeking a $500 million lifeline from the White House, but talks failed to yield a deal. Source: NPR News.

item.title: James stars as Lakers set up Thunder showdown | BBC News
item.description: LeBron James scores 28 points as the Los Angeles Lakers beat the Houston Rockets to set up a Western Conference semi-final play-off against reigning NBA champions Oklahoma City Thunder. Source: BBC News.

item.title: Red squirrels 'close to extinction' in England | BBC News
item.description: A petition set up by campaign group Save Our Reds, has attracted more than 75,000 signatures. Source: BBC News.

item.title: Air Force says former Qatari 747 will be ready to fly as Air Force One this summer | NPR News
item.description: The U.S. Air Force has finished modifying and testing a Boeing 747 jet donated by Qatar for temporary use as Air Force One and expects to have it ready for President Trump to use this summer. Source: NPR News.

item.title: The striker quietly making a big noise at Arsenal | BBC News
item.description: As Arsenal travel to Lyon in the Champions League semi-final second leg, BBC Sport assesses the importance of unsung striker Stina Blackstenius. Source: BBC News.

item.title: U.S. to withdraw 5,000 troops from Germany in next 6-12 months | NPR News
item.description: The United States will withdraw about 5,000 troops from Germany, the Pentagon said Friday, fulfilling President Donald Trump's threat as he clashes with the German leader over the U.S. war with Iran. Source: NPR News.

item.title: 'Shy' Anderson on England nerves and becoming a leader | BBC News
item.description: Nottingham Forest midfielder Elliot Anderson tells Kelly Somers about coming out of his shell to become a leader. Source: BBC News.

item.title: These twins were born within minutes of each other - but have different dads | BBC News
item.description: Lavinia and Michelle are the only case of twins with different fathers to be recorded in the UK. Source: BBC News.

item.title: 'If we sleep they bite': Rats and weasels infest camps for displaced Gazans | BBC News
item.description: In the Gaza Strip, the daily battles are now with rats, weasels, and other pests spreading diseases. Source: BBC News.

item.title: 'I bought a baseball cap to hide my kippah': Jews observe first Shabbat after Golders Green attack | BBC News
item.description: British Jews tell the BBC they are agonising over whether to stick to their usual routine this Sabbath. Source: BBC News.

item.title: Protests may need to be stopped in some cases, PM suggests | BBC News
item.description: The PM tells the BBC he is concerned about the "cumulative" effect of marches on the Jewish community. Source: BBC News.

item.title: What to know about Spirit Airlines amid reports airline preparing to cease operations | ABC News
item.description: The Wall Street Journal reported Spirit Airlines will cease operations after a rescue deal from the White House apparently fell through. Source: ABC News.

item.title: Wyoming celebrates 'nuclear renaissance' as feds approve license for a new reactor | NPR News
item.description: Construction of an advanced nuclear power plant partly funded by the U.S. government -billed as the first of its kind this century, is now underway in Wyoming. The Bill Gates-backed company says its technology is proven but there are still hurdles to nuclear. Source: NPR News.

item.title: Trump claims other presidents flouted war powers law. It's a mixed record | BBC News
item.description: Both Bushes and Ronald Reagan won congressional authorisation for wars, but Obama and Clinton ducked the requirement. Source: BBC News.
